name: No Lorem ipsum or template placeholder data
description: Detects Lorem ipsum text or generic placeholder data (John Doe, Jane Smith, user@example.com, 123 Main St, foo bar) shown to users.
rationale: ISO 9241-11 defines usability as the extent to which a user can achieve goals with effectiveness in their context of use. Lorem ipsum and placeholder data signal the data layer isn't connected: the user sees an unfinished prototype, not a product. Real content or empty states are both honest. Placeholder content is the dishonest middle. This is a self-evident stub tell: shipped apps should not contain unshipped content.
pass_criteria: No visible text containing 'lorem ipsum', 'dolor sit amet', 'John Doe', 'Jane Doe', 'user@example.com', '123 Main St', or other canonical placeholder strings.
